description: Installs the TypeScript language server for LSP clients on a private node runtime, independent of any node in the image.
name: TypeScript Language Server

nodeVersion.description: Version of the private node runtime that runs the server, as X.Y.Z. Features pinning the same version share one runtime copy.

typescriptVersion.description: Version of the typescript package that backs the server when the workspace has none. TypeScript 7+ is the native rewrite without tsserver and cannot back this server.

version.description: Version of the typescript-language-server package to install.
